subject: School Committee Combined Wards
overview: The Medford Charter Study Committee approved combining wards into four school committee districts and established the appointment framework and residency rules for future charter review bodies. It also voted to forward draft language for Articles 1 and 5 to the Collins Center while tabling ordinance reviews and residency rules for multi-member bodies.

items.title: School Committee Ward Combinations
items.summary: Adopted Option 2 to combine city wards into four school committee districts pairing Wards 1 and 7, 2 and 3, 4 and 5, and 6 and 8 so that each district contains a school.

items.title: Charter Review Body Composition and Eligibility
items.summary: Voted to establish a nine-member charter review committee with four members appointed by the mayor, four by the city council, and one by the school committee, and approved a requirement that all appointees be Medford residents.

items.title: Periodic Review of Ordinances
items.summary: Tabled discussion on periodic ordinance reviews to request analysis and feedback from the Collins Center on common practices in other municipalities.

items.title: Charter Articles 1 and 5
items.summary: Approved forwarding standard boilerplate language from the model template for Articles 1 and 5 to the Collins Center for drafting.

items.title: Article 9 and Future Meeting Planning
items.summary: Discussed proposed additions to Article 9 including residency rules for multi-member bodies, postponing further action to a meeting scheduled for June 13.

items.title: Public Comment
items.summary: Opened the floor for public comment, but no attendees spoke.
